name: storyblocks
description: Search and license Storyblocks stock video, audio, and images (API v2) using your own Storyblocks API keys. Zero dependencies.
long_description: Exposes the Storyblocks API v2 as MCP tools. This is a bring-your-own-credentials extension: you supply the public and private API keys issued by Storyblocks (free test keys at developer.storyblocks.com/register). The server signs every request with Storyblocks' HMAC-SHA256 scheme locally; your private key is never transmitted. Search footage, motion backgrounds, templates, music, sound effects, photos, illustrations, and vectors with the full set of filters; fetch item metadata and download formats; get licensed full-quality download links; browse categories and curated collections; find similar items; list expiring content; and manage YouTube Content ID claims on Storyblocks audio. This is an independent community project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Storyblocks.

public_key.title: Storyblocks public key
public_key.description: The public API key issued by Storyblocks (sent as the APIKEY parameter). Get free test keys at https://developer.storyblocks.com/register.

private_key.title: Storyblocks private key
private_key.description: The secret API key issued by Storyblocks. Used only to compute the request HMAC locally; never transmitted.

default_user_id.title: Default user id
default_user_id.description: Opaque identifier for the end user, required by Storyblocks on search and download requests. Do not use a name or email. Can be overridden per tool call.

default_project_id.title: Default project id
default_project_id.description: Opaque identifier for the project, required by Storyblocks on search and download requests. Can be overridden per tool call.
